brief:
Israeli military fire wounded two Palestinians during a raid on a home in Qusra, a village in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian Red Crescent said. Those struck were aged 70 and 15. The circumstances surrounding the operation and what prompted the military action remain unclear from available reports.

Israeli settlers have conducted repeated operations in the area, according to Middle East Eye. The incident adds to a pattern of armed confrontations affecting Palestinian communities across the West Bank.
